title: Chief Legal Officer (CLO)
description:
Role Summary
The Chief Legal Officer (CLO) is the senior legal executive responsible for overseeing the organization's legal strategy, governance, regulatory compliance, corporate affairs, and risk management. The CLO serves as a trusted advisor to the CEO, Board of Directors, and executive leadership team, ensuring the organization operates within legal and regulatory frameworks while supporting business growth and strategic initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
1. Legal Strategy & Executive Advisory

• Serve as the principal legal advisor to the CEO, Board, and executive leadership team.

• Develop and execute the organization's legal strategy in alignment with business objectives.

• Provide legal guidance on strategic initiatives, mergers and acquisitions, partnerships, and corporate restructuring.

• Anticipate and mitigate legal risks associated with business operations and growth.

2. Corporate Governance

• Ensure compliance with corporate governance standards and best practices.

• Advise the Board and executive leadership on fiduciary responsibilities and governance matters.

• Manage board resolutions, corporate records, and governance policies.

• Support corporate secretarial functions where applicable.

3. Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management

• Oversee enterprise-wide legal and regulatory compliance programs.

• Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and industry standards.

• Monitor regulatory developments and assess their impact on the organization.

• Develop legal risk mitigation frameworks and compliance controls.

4. Contracts & Commercial Transactions

• Lead the negotiation, drafting, and review of significant commercial agreements.

• Oversee contract management processes and legal documentation standards.

• Provide legal support for strategic partnerships, vendor agreements, and customer contracts.

• Ensure contractual arrangements adequately protect organizational interests.

5. Litigation & Dispute Resolution

• Manage litigation strategy and external legal counsel relationships.

• Oversee dispute resolution, arbitration, mediation, and regulatory investigations.

• Assess litigation exposure and recommend appropriate legal actions.

• Ensure effective management of legal claims and liabilities.

6. Mergers, Acquisitions & Corporate Transactions

• Lead legal due diligence for mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures, and investments.

• Structure transactions to minimize legal and regulatory risk.

• Manage external advisors and legal workstreams throughout transaction lifecycles.

• Support post-merger integration activities from a legal perspective.

7. Ethics, Compliance & Corporate Integrity

• Promote a culture of ethics, integrity, and compliance.

• Oversee whistleblower programs, investigations, and ethics policies.

• Ensure adherence to anti-corruption, anti-bribery, and corporate conduct standards.

• Lead internal investigations involving legal and compliance matters.

8. Legal Team Leadership

• Build and lead a high-performing legal and compliance function.

• Manage legal budgets and external counsel expenditures.

• Develop legal talent and succession planning initiatives.

• Establish legal operations processes and performance metrics.

Qualifications & Experience

• Juris Doctor (JD), LLB, or equivalent law degree.

• Licensed attorney admitted to practice in a relevant jurisdiction.

• 15+ years of progressive legal experience.

• Minimum 5+ years in a senior legal leadership role (General Counsel, CLO, Head of Legal, Legal Director).

• Experience advising executive leadership and boards of directors.

• Strong background in corporate law, governance, compliance, commercial contracts, and regulatory matters.

• Experience managing complex legal transactions and litigation.

title: Abstractor - Real Estate Research
description:
About Capitol Lien

Capitol Lien is a dynamic, fast-growing public records research company providing due diligence services to the title insurance, real estate, legal, and financial industries. For more than 30 years, we’ve delivered trusted real estate and UCC research to clients nationwide. As we continue to grow, we are seeking an experienced Real Estate Abstractor to join our team and deliver unmatched-quality research for our clients.
Real Estate Abstractor Job Description
Search and abstract all types of public records, including real estate and court records at county recorders, courthouses, and online sources, and professionally deliver the results to Capitol Lien clients, while ensuring the accuracy and integrity of the information reported. High attention to detail and accuracy is critical in this role.
Required Experience and Qualifications:

• Minimum 2+ years of hands-on experience abstracting real estate records (current owner, two-owner, full search or similar) at county recorder offices and/or online platforms.

• Proven ability to proficiently read and interpret legal descriptions (metes and bounds, platted, sectional)

• Working knowledge of property tax records and how to verify and report tax status.

• Familiarity with title industry standards, terminology and reporting expectations.

• Valid driver’s license (required for in-person courthouse and recorder office visits).

• Strong clerical, typing, and proofreading skills.

• Solid grammar, spelling and written communication ability.

• Internet and computer proficiency, including Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Gmail, Drive).

• Dependable, reliable and accountable to deadlines.

• Strong self-management and interpersonal skills.

Location physical preference of upper-midwest, i.e. MN, WI area.
Detailed Work Activities:

• Perform research within real estate and court records, according to the internal Abstractor Job Standards

• Proficiently read legal descriptions;

• Examine and report on property tax records;

• Complete all orders within the expected timeframe while maintaining due diligence to ensure accuracy.

• Follow all client instructions, understanding that each client and order may have slight variations in reporting.

• Self-manage and prioritize orders based on due date or special requirements such as rush orders and special projects;

• Manage inbound and outbound work queue;

• Communicate with clients on quote requests, order status, ETA, and any other additional information needed;

• Ensure every communication with clients is professional and courteous.

• Maintain proper email etiquette, including greetings and salutations;

• Update notes with any client communication regarding an order.

• Analyze results reports for spelling and grammar before submittal.

• Deliver all client reports via each client's preferred method of transmittal.

• Verify and document that each order's pricing and fees are accurate, including copy costs;

• Maintain an accurate mileage log for travel and submit by the deadline.

• Keep organized receipts for out-of-pocket expenses and submit for reimbursement on time.

• Notify county personnel of errors discovered while searching public records;

• Update your team and the immediate supervisor of workload status and availability to assist others;

• Offer assistance to team members as workload allows.

• Perform any additional duties, tasks, and responsibilities as assigned.

What We Offer

• Competitive salary

• Collaborative, fun, and inclusive work environment;

• Fully remote position;

• Comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

Capitol Lien is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Senior Electrical Product Engineer - Maritime Engineering
tags: Maritime & Maneuver Dominance : Undersea Dominance - Engineering & Operations : Software Engineering
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Role

The Senior Product Engineer is the primary electrical design engineering presence on the production floor, bridging the gap between design intent and production execution. The role sits within Platform Engineering and is based primarily at the production site, dispositioning nonconformances and Material Review Board (MRB) actions for electrical systems and sub-assemblies, resolving design questions in real time, and closing the loop between production and design so that issues get root caused and fixed at the source. To hold that authority credibly, this role also contributes to upstream electrical design - architecture, analysis, schematics, and design reviews - so they have the depth needed to make sound disposition decisions on the floor. This is a senior individual contributor role requiring strong technical judgement in electrical and power systems engineering, the ability to operate autonomously in a fast-paced production environment, and the credibility to influence both design engineers and production teams. You will be expected to drive systemic improvements, cutting repeat nonconformances through changes to the design and documentation, as well as resolving individual issues.

Key Responsibilities

Production Floor Engineering Support

• Serve as the primary electrical design engineering point of contact on the production floor for assigned programs and product lines

• Represent the design authority at Material Review Board (MRB) for electrical systems, working with Quality and Manufacturing to minimise production hold time without compromising product safety and integrity

• Resolve production process-blockers, design ambiguities, and schematic/drawing interpretation issues in real time, exercising engineering judgement within defined authority boundaries

• Provide rapid-response engineering support and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to Production, Quality, and Test teams for electrical nonconformance resolution, use-as-is/rework/scrap decisions, and repair dispositions

• Identify and escalate systemic electrical design issues to core Design Engineering teams with clear problem statements, data, and recommended corrective actions

• Perform detailed electrical calculations, simulations, and analysis to support MRB dispositions, deviation requests, and use-as-is justifications (e.g. power budgets, thermal derating, circuit analysis, connector/harness assessments)

Electrical Design Contribution

• Contribute to the design, development and integration of electrical systems and subsystems, maintaining the technical depth needed to hold disposition authority on the production floor

• Perform detailed electrical calculations, simulations and analysis (circuit analysis, power budgets, thermal derating, EMC/EMI) to support both design decisions and MRB dispositions

• Participate in design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR) and contribute to system-level trade studies

• Collaborate cross-functionally with mechanical, software, and systems engineering to integrate electrical systems into the vehicle

Design Intent Translation & Multi-Site Support

• Support the translation of electrical design intent into production-executable work across multiple product versions, configurations, and manufacturing sites

title: Software Engineer 5 – Agent Platform, AI Platform
description:
At Netflix , our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.
At Netflix , we want to entertain the world, and we're constantly innovating on how entertainment is imagined, created, and delivered to a global audience. Increasingly, that innovation is powered by AI - and Netflix is making a deliberate bet to become AI Native, with AI woven into how we build products, create content, and run the company.
The Opportunity
The Agent Platform team gives Netflix engineers the infrastructure to go from zero to a production-grade AI agent without reinventing the wheel. We own the foundational building blocks the whole company builds on: the Model Gateway (unified access to external LLMs like Claude, GPT, and Gemini), the Assistance API for conversational use cases, the MCP Gateway that connects agents to Netflix 's internal systems and knowledge, our Agent SDK, and an end-to-end evaluation stack.
The work has moved well beyond chat completions. Teams across Netflix are now building agents - systems that plan, call tools, observe results, and iterate - and they depend on us for the infrastructure to do that reliably and to know whether their agents are actually any good. We're a small team with outsized leverage: what we ship becomes the foundation for AI across all of Netflix .
What you will do:

• Design, build, and operate the Agent SDK and MCP Gateway that Netflix engineers use to build, deploy, and run AI agents in production.

• Build agents and agent infrastructure across the full lifecycle - plan/act/observe loops, tool and MCP integrations, deployment, and day-2 operations.

• Make evaluation a first-class part of the platform: build the tracing, eval suites, and quality signals that let teams measure agents, catch regressions, and iterate to make them better.

• Own reliability, observability, and guardrails for non-deterministic systems running at very high scale

• Lead cross-functional initiatives with ML scientists, data scientists, product managers, and other AI Platform teams.

• Rapidly iterate with users to improve the developer experience while establishing durable foundational capabilities.

Desired Background:

• 8+ years of software engineering experience with a track record of delivering quality results.

• Hands-on experience building, deploying, operating, AND evaluating LLM agents in production - not just chat-completion apps or prototypes.

• Experience with one or more agent frameworks/SDKs (Strands, OpenAI Agents SDK, Anthropic Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph, pydantic-ai, CrewAI, Google ADK) and with tool/function calling and MCP.

• Experience with LLM/agent evaluation and observability - building eval suites, tracing, and quality measurement, then iterating on results (Braintrust, LangSmith, W&B, or equivalent).

• Strong experience building SDKs and APIs for internal or external developers.

• Strong fundamentals in building and operating scalable, observable, fault-tolerant distributed systems.

• Proficiency in Python (and Python packaging tooling) plus one of Java, Go, C/C++, Rust, or Zig. Familiarity with our stack - Temporal, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes - is a plus.

• Experience with large-scale build, release, CI/CD, and observability methods.

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $466,000.00 - $750,000.0

About Proof

Proof is the service-of-process marketplace modernizing how legal documents move through the real world. 10,000 law firms, from small practices to the AmLaw 100, trust us with documents that have legal consequences: a serve has to reach the right person, at the right address, under the right rules, with a court-ready affidavit proving what happened.

We're one of the fastest-growing tech enabled services companies in the U.S., and legal tech is one of the most exciting places to build software right now. We're also still early enough that you'll help shape the culture, not just inherit it. Expect real autonomy, the latest AI tools on a modern stack, plus engineers and designers who care about craft as much as you do.

The role

Due process starts at a door. Before a lawsuit can move forward, the person being sued has to be properly notified, and for thousands of cases every day, that happens through a process server using our mobile app. It's one of the most critical steps in the litigation system.

As a Product Manager on the Server Experience and Fulfilment team, you'll own the product experience that helps those servers get it right and on time, from understanding requirements and planning attempts to capturing reliable evidence of service. Your goal is to make that work easier for servers, more predictable for the law firms relying on it, and more profitable for our marketplace overall.

What you'll own

• Planning and attempts. How servers plan their day, sequence attempts, work high-volume addresses, and see which jobs are at risk before a deadline passes.

• Job requirements. Helping servers act on each job's legal requirements at the right moment, across states and counties.

• Evidence of service. The capture and verification behind every attempt: location, time, photos, eligibility checks. Raise the quality bar without slowing servers down, even with no signal.

• Fewer handoffs. Deciding what belongs in the app, what AI and automation can handle, and what still needs one of our service specialists.

• Efficient dispatch. How job offers get packaged, priced, and distributed to servers, and the product systems behind server pay.

Your team and scope

You're joining an established team that has driven some of Proof's biggest wins over the last two years. It moves quickly, ships with impact, and has built a best-in-class mobile app for process servers.

You'll report to the CPO and, as a hands-on IC, partner with a dedicated engineering squad and our design team on discovery, analysis, and delivery. You're accountable for the squad's multi-quarter roadmap. Day to day, you'll work side by side with a world-class operations team that handles server recruitment, rate negotiation, and risk and compliance, and with four other PMs who lead the law firm experience, platform automation, filing, and integrations.

What success looks like in year one

• More jobs meet their service deadlines, without more avoidable reattempts.

• Less avoidable specialist work per job, with service quality continuing to improve.

• More complete, trustworthy evidence from the field, and fewer downstream corrections caused by missing or incorrect server inputs.

• Servers find the work easier, and it shows in retention: more of our best servers stay active and take on more jobs.

Who we're hiring

You'll be a strong fit if:

• You've owned a consequential workflow from identifying the problem through launch and adoption, and can explain what you chose not to build, the tradeoffs you made, and the results.

• You've built a mobile product people depend on to do their jobs: drivers, couriers, field technicians, inspectors, or similar.

• You think in systems. You see how a change in the app ripples through dispatch, operations, and the law firm on the other end, and you design automation that holds up as volume grows.

You will own the roadmap, requirements, delivery, and adoption of the tools, data, and platform behind that signal, partnering with Engineering to build systems that support planning and execution across OpenAI.

If you are looking for a meaningful career where people work and act with passion, rethink the existing and always strive to find the best solution - you have come to the right place. We develop future technologies to relentlessly make supply chains better.
We are a leader in supply chain software solutions, helping organizations streamline operations, reduce costs, and improve efficiency.
The Senior Manager, Deal Desk - North America serves as the commercial quarterback for strategic, complex and non-standard North America transactions and helps establish the global Deal Desk operating model. The role partners with Sales from early deal strategy through signature and booking readiness to structure commercially viable transactions, drive timely decisions and ensure deals are properly approved, documented and operationally executable.
This is a hands-on player-coach role without direct reports. In addition to leading North America transactions, the Senior Manager helps establish global intake, governance, service standards and execution practices, and supports APAC transactions as required. As the function scales, the role is expected to assume leadership of regional Deal Desk resources.
What a day in the life looks like:

• Serve as the primary Deal Desk partner for North America Sales, leading complex and strategic transactions while advising on deal structure, pricing, commercial terms, negotiations, and financial analysis.

• Drive cross-functional deal execution by partnering with Sales, Finance, Legal, Accounting, Tax, Product, Professional Services, Security, and Operations to resolve issues and ensure timely approvals.

• Draft, negotiate, and manage commercial agreements, ensuring compliance with company policies and readiness for booking, billing, revenue recognition, and delivery requirements.

• Oversee contract lifecycle management, including documentation, approvals, execution, and alignment with CRM/CPQ systems and approved deal structures.

• Identify opportunities to improve processes, controls, reporting, and automation while analyzing deal trends to enhance commercial effectiveness and scalability.

• Provide coaching, cross-regional support, and leadership within a fast-paced global environment, including quarter-end and multi-time-zone coverage.

What you bring to the team:

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• 8+ years of experience in Deal Desk, commercial finance, revenue operations, sales operations, pricing, or a related function.

• Proven experience structuring and executing complex enterprise software, SaaS, or technology transactions.

• Strong commercial, financial, and contractual acumen, including pricing, profitability, revenue recognition, and non-standard deal analysis.

• Experience partnering across functions to drive deal execution, process improvements, governance, and approval workflows.

• Proficiency with Salesforce and CPQ platforms; CLM and ERP experience is a plus.

• Excellent negotiation, communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills, with the ability to influence decisions in a fast-paced environment.

​
Base salary: $144,530.00 USD. Plus bonus opportunities based on experience, performance, and market factors.

At Infios , we're not just looking for employees; we're looking for partners in innovation, growth, and purpose. title: Sr. Implementation Program Manager - Utah
description:
Job Description:
Senior Implementation Program Manager - Utah

About the Role
Packsize is seeking a Senior Implementation Program Manager to lead complex customer implementations from post-sale kickoff through go-live, stabilization, and formal handoff. This role combines disciplined program management with customer success leadership, ensuring solutions are delivered on time and within budget while preparing customer teams to operate, adopt, and realize sustained value.
What You’ll Do
Lead the customer implementation

• Own customer-facing implementation leadership from kickoff through formal closeout and handoff, adapting governance for complex, multi-site, enterprise, or high-risk deployments.

• Translate the sold solution and customer requirements into an outcomes-based plan with clear scope, milestones, owners, decision rights, dependencies, and completion criteria.

• Build trusted relationships with customer leaders and cross-functional teams, aligning them around critical dates, readiness expectations, decisions, and implementation outcomes.
Drive program execution and risk management

• Coordinate with Sales, engineering, Service, Operations, and other partners to confirm requirements and maintain the Implementation Specification Document and integrated implementation plan.

• Manage schedules, budgets, costs, customer prerequisites, and cross-functional commitments across multiple concurrent implementations.

• Maintain the RAID log, remove roadblocks, and escalate material scope, schedule, technical, customer, or commercial risks with clear recommendations.
Build readiness, adoption, and go-live success

• Drive customer readiness across facilities, workflows, staffing, training, materials, systems, and operational support using clear completion criteria.

• Lead onboarding, stakeholder alignment, communications, training coordination, and practical change management while surfacing adoption risks early.

• Coordinate go/no-go readiness reviews, Customer Acceptance Testing, and go-live execution with transparent risks, owners, and contingency plans.

• Lead early-life stabilization and confirm readiness, acceptance, training, and early-adoption outcomes before implementation closeout.
Close, hand off, and improve

• Execute a checklist-based handoff documenting the operating state, adoption baseline, open items, risks, named owners, and next-step success plan for ongoing technical and commercial teams.

• Provide concise status, decisions, trade-offs, and recommendations to customers and Packsize leaders, using influence to align teams and move issues forward.

• Complete closeout artifacts and after-action reviews, using root-cause analysis to improve implementation practices, governance, and customer experience.

How Success Will Be Measured

•
Reliable execution: Milestones, schedule, budget, risks, and escalations are managed effectively.

•
Customer readiness and adoption: People, processes, facilities, systems, and training are ready for launch and early use.

•
Successful go-live: Customer acceptance is achieved, operations stabilize, and critical launch issues are closed.

•
Quality handoff and improvement: Open items and ownership are clearly transferred, with lessons applied to future implementations.

Measures may be tailored to the scope and complexity of the assigned implementation portfolio.
What You'll Bring

• Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Five or more years of project or program management experience leading complex customer-facing implementations and multiple concurrent priorities.

• Demonstrated customer and change leadership, including the ability to build trust, navigate conflict, and influence senior stakeholders and matrixed teams.

• Strong technical acumen across hardware, software, integrations, and customer operations, with the curiosity to learn complex solutions quickly.

• Clear executive communication and sound

title: VP of Business Development, National Payers
description:
Everlywell is a digital health company pioneering the next generation of biomarker intelligence-combining AI-powered technology with human insight to deliver personalized, actionable health answers. We transform complex biomarker data into life-changing insights-seamlessly integrating advanced diagnostics, virtual care, and patient engagement to reshape how and where health happens.

Over the past decade, Everlywell has delivered close to 1 billion personalized health insights, transforming care for 60 million people and powering hundreds of enterprise partners. In 2025, an estimated 1 in 94 U.S. adults received an Everlywell test, solidifying our spot as the #1 at-home testing company in the country. Fueled by AI and built for scale, we’re breaking down barriers, closing care gaps, and unlocking a more connected healthcare experience that is smarter, faster, and more personalized.

We are hiring a VP of Business Development, National Payers to drive Everlywell 's revenue growth with the largest national health plans, such as UnitedHealthcare, Elevance Health, Humana, Aetna/CVS Health, Cigna, and Centene. Reporting directly to the Chief Commercial Officer, this senior, quota-carrying role owns three things: winning new logos, expanding into new markets, and growing overall revenue with existing national payer clients - across Medicare Advantage, ACA, commercial, and Medicaid lines of business.

You'll navigate large, matrixed organizations, build enterprise-level relationships, and turn first programs into multi-line, multi-market partnerships. You'll work hand in hand with Account Management: they own day-to-day relationships, delivery, and renewals; you lead new opportunities, enterprise expansion deals, and new-market entry within those clients, with shared account plans and shared growth goals.

Responsibilities:

• Own an annual growth quota for national payers covering new-logo wins, new-market expansion, and revenue growth with existing clients

• Build, qualify, and close pipeline through prospecting, your industry network, referrals, and events

• Identify and win expansion opportunities with existing national payer clients - new lines of business, business units, states and markets, programs, and populations

• Partner with Account Management on joint account plans for existing clients: align on growth targets, executive relationships, and who leads each opportunity, and keep handoffs seamless

• Develop enterprise account strategies for each target payer: map business units, budget owners, decision process, and procurement path

• Lead complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles with payer executives across quality and Star Ratings, population health, care management, product, network, and procurement/vendor management

• Craft tailored value propositions for each line of business - Medicare Advantage, ACA, commercial/fully insured, and Medicaid - and for enterprise-wide agreements

• Develop strong pitch materials, proposals, RFP responses, and business cases in partnership with Marketing

• Partner with Pricing, Finance, and Legal/Contracting to structure enterprise deals (e.g., master agreements, multi-line statements of work) and own development of statements of work and contracts

• Keep HubSpot current and accurate; forecast monthly, quarterly, and annual bookings to the Chief Commercial Officer

• Maintain in-depth knowledge of national payer priorities, market conditions, competitors, and market offerings

• Represent Everlywell at conferences, seminars, webinars, and other external-facing events

• Bring the voice of the market into product and commercial roadmaps

• Report on business development metrics and KPIs (pipeline coverage, win rate, cycle time, new-logo and expansion bookings)

Who You Are / Job Requirements:

• 10+ years of enterprise business development or sales experience selling to health plans

• Proven record of winning new logos and growing business with major national health plans

title: Global Hotel Partnerships Manager (East Coast based)
description:
With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most - their team, their guests, and their bottom line - while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion. 

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

 

About the Job

We are seeking a high-impact relationship builder to own and grow OpenTable's most strategic hotel partnerships worldwide. As the Global Hotel Partnerships Manager, you will be the primary architect of OpenTable's relationships with the world's leading hotel brands and management groups - sitting at the critical intersection of business development, product evolution, and global operations.

You will manage a portfolio of high-value, Tier-1 hotel partnerships, leading complex global negotiations, driving adoption of OpenTable's technology suite, and ensuring our products are seamlessly integrated into the world's most prestigious hotel portfolios. Success in this role means growing revenue and retention through a consultative, data-driven approach while serving as the connective tissue between partner executives, their technical teams, and OpenTable's internal functions.

This is a remote position, with a preference for candidates based on the East Coast. The role requires up to 25% domestic and international travel. 

Responsibilities

• Act as the primary relationship owner for Tier-1 global hotel partners (e.g., Marriott, Hilton, Four Seasons, IHG), overseeing relationship health, retention, and revenue growth across regions.

• Lead end-to-end negotiation and contracting for global service agreements, co-marketing contracts, and technical addendums, structuring terms that maximize strategic value across diverse markets.

• Develop and execute profitability and revenue strategies that exceed growth and retention goals - including auditing financial structures such as rebate programs and implementing pricing models that increase average partner revenue.

• Drive global adoption of high-value features and products, including OpenTable Pro, Private Dining Instant Booking, and Automated Guest Codes.

• Serve as the bridge between partner technical teams and OpenTable Engineering to deploy API products (e.g., Sync, CRM, Booking), and navigate enterprise-level security audits, SSO implementation, SOC 2 reporting, and complex data privacy requirements.

• Build consensus across cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance, Sales Ops) to align contract terms, product requests, and account plans, and provide end-to-end support for product releases and the subsequent go-to-market strategy.

• Prepare and lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and "Year in Review" performance audits for C-suite stakeholders, and design sales enablement and training materials that equip leadership and account management with hotel expertise.

• Represent OpenTable at major industry trade shows and conferences, presenting on topics meaningful to the global travel and hospitality industry.

• Own the administrative side of the partnership, including documentation of client engagement in Salesforce, stewardship of hotel-specific resource sites, and strategic communication flows.

• The role requires up to 25% domestic and international travel. 

Minimum Qualifications

• 5+ years of relevant experience in account management, strategic partnerships, or business development, ideally within the hospitality or travel technology sector.

• Proven track record of owning and growing a portfolio of high-value accounts or partners against pre-set objectives.

title: Business Lead - Pitstops
description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

The opportunity

Pitstops are the local shops that power Relay. Every day, thousands of corner shops, newsagents and convenience stores take in parcels from our vans, hand them to couriers on bikes and in cars, and serve customers dropping off and picking up. They’re the reason we can deliver faster and cheaper than the big carriers. We’ve grown from a few hundred pitstops to thousands in two years. Next is the rest of the UK and the US.

This role owns making that network work. That means the right pitstops, at a pay that works for them and for us. When one goes wrong, you see it the same day in parcels left behind and routes running late. You’ll build the systems that stop that happening, and fix it fast when it does.

About the role

- Pitstop capacity vs required. Enough active, open pitstops with headroom in each zone. Working with the sales team to close capacity gaps as we grow and expand and the data team to model how our capacity will grow and change as we make it easier to work with us.

- Undelivered and uncollected parcels on PUDO routes. The daily rate, and how fast it’s recovered. You own the strategy for the automated processes and app flows that drive it down.

- Pitstop pricing economics. Pay per bag and scan, and the target rate by area, understanding how this impacts our contribution margin as a business.

- Activation throughput. Getting signed pitstops live and up to speed as fast as possible. We’ve grown from a few hundred pitstops to thousands in two years. Now we need to do that across the UK and in the US.

What you’ll do

1. Lead pitstop strategy and metrics. Turn the outcomes above into the parts you can control, a roadmap and named owners. Work with Engineering and Data to deliver it. Hold a weekly results review: what we expected, what happened, what we do next.

2. Own delivery-today and recovery for pitstops. Rejections, closures, caps and redirects. Make sure each failure type has a playbook and an owner, and track how often recovery works. Replace scrappy manual processes with automated systems, fast.

3. Own pricing. Find opportunities for pricing experiments, such as variable rates. Set guardrails and rollback triggers. Recommend rates by area, ensuring we stay in line with competitors. Work with Commercial, who own the rate quoted at signing.

4. Make Relay easy to run alongside a shop. Pitstops are small businesses working with us on the side of their main trade. Every scan, bag and app screen costs them time. Understand what it’s like to be a pitstop. Remove friction from their day, and make sure the volume and pay they get from us stay worth it.

What you’ll need

- Ownership. You run outcomes, not tasks. A good week is one where the metrics you own move the right way, quickly.

- Comfort with data. You can read a dashboard, question a number and frame an experiment. SQL is a plus, not a must.

- Ops judgement. You know when to fix today’s problem and

title: Senior Product Designer

ABOUT CLIPBOARD

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company https://www.ycombinator.com/topcompanies/ and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to own up leveling the design of our core experiences across our worker and workplace apps.

You'll partner closely with product and engineering to define vision, build roadmaps, and solve real problems for our customers. You'll talk to customers regularly and use what you learn to form a clear point of view on how to build solutions for their needs. You'll explore multiple directions, design user flows, visuals, and interactions, build detailed prototypes to test them with customers, and iterate until what ships is polished, intuitive, and impactful.

This is an opportunity to build products in an industry that delivers real impact for our workers and workplaces and, enables better care outcomes for their patients. Beyond the features you own, you'll be working with other designers to dramatically raise the craft of everything we build. Sharper visual design, tighter interactions, more consistency across surfaces, and more care in the details throughout the experiences our customers use every day.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own design for core features end to end across the worker and facility apps, from research and problem definition through specs and launch.

- Serve as the primary experience voice for your team, framing ambiguous problems clearly enough that partners can see the vision and build from it.

- Partner with PMs on planning and prioritization, using user needs and business context to decide what gets built and when.

- Set a high bar for craft and push visual and interaction quality across everything you design in our products.

- Build detailed, high-fidelity prototypes that show how an experience looks, moves, and feels.

- Design within our design system and contribute back to it, working with other designers and engineers to get new components and patterns built into the codebase.

- Talk to customers regularly to understand their problems, and use research and data to shape the experiences that solve them.

- Integrate AI throughout your process, from synthesizing research and analyzing competitors to generating concepts, writing copy, and building working prototypes.

- Take accountability for quality at every stage of a project, and above all for what ships.

SKILLS YOU’LL NEED

- 5+ years of product design experience and a portfolio of shipped work that shows strong visual and interaction craft and clear end-to-end thinking.

- Experience owning a product area with little oversight, taking ambiguous problems from definition through launch and iteration.

- Deep attention to typography, layout, hierarchy, color, spacing, motion, and interaction detail.

- Fluency in Figma and AI-powered prototyping tools, with experience designing for iOS, Android, and web.

- Experience working within and contributing to a design system, including partnering with other designers and engineers to get changes built in code.

- Strong systems thinking, with the ability to design for interconnected flows and complex existing systems.

- Experience talking directly to customers, and using research and product data to inform design decisions.

title: Staff Web Application Security Specialist
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Staff Information Security Engineer to join our team. This is a Hybrid role, reporting to the Director, Software Development Engineering in the Engineering department. 

In this role, we are building an Adversarial Exposure Validation platform where autonomous agents identify and validate real-world security exposures. As a Staff Web Application Security Specialist, you will shape the platform's web application and API testing capabilities. This is a deeply hands-on role for someone who uncovers the vulnerabilities automated scanners miss and translates that expertise into realistic, repeatable playbooks that our agents run safely.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

• Create and refine realistic web application and API testing playbooks

• Evaluate agent-generated findings and exploitation attempts for correctness, evidence quality, and safety, and approve, constrain, or reject execution against guardrails

• Identify coverage gaps in modern application architectures, authentication systems, and multi-tenant SaaS platforms

• Reproduce and validate complex findings manually and safely

• Work with software engineers to improve how the platform discovers, tests, and reports web vulnerabilities

Who You Are (Success Profile)

• You act as an owner with an authentic passion for operational excellence and a strong bias for action, navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and tactical execution.

• You foster a high-trust, collaborative environment that values transparent feedback, healthy debate, and shared team success above individual accolades.

• You champion the customer experience by anchoring engineering decisions in solving critical, real-world problems for both internal stakeholders and external users.

• You bring deep technical curiosity and an innovative mindset to solve complex architectural challenges, continuously seeking more resilient, automated, and scalable solutions.

• You lead with unwavering integrity and high accountability, cultivating trust across organizations through transparent communication and consistent follow-through.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

• Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving

• Domain Experience: 7-11 years of hands-on web application and API penetration testing, including complex vulnerability discovery across multi-tenant SaaS and cloud-hosted architectures

• Web Stacks & Identity Protocols: Strong understanding of modern web stacks, REST/GraphQL APIs, and deep expertise in identity and authentication protocols (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, session management)

• Advanced Exploitation & Methodology: Hands-on mastery of advanced exploitation techniques (IDOR/BOLA, injections, XSS, SSRF, bypasses, race conditions) guided by deep familiarity with OWAS

Monitors the Maintenance & Repair System (Prime) for all service orders. Coordinates with Service Order Manager or other management as required in support of service orders.
Remains fully engaged with all recurring maintenance activities, goals and objectives.

Candidate must have 5 years’ experience (preferably DoD military) in wetted fueling system - Piping, mechanical work, fueling upgrades, fuel hydrant systems, tank work, coatings work, inspections, and repairs.
Knowledge of construction practices, UFGS, UFC, ASME codes, API, North American and / or international standards and principles related to the POL system design, construction, inspection, and repair processes
Ability to obtain or maintain a government security clearance, and/or Favorable Background Investigation (BI)
Ability to read and interpret construction project drawings and specifications
Proficiency in MS Word, Excel, Outlook.
Possesses effective communication, interpersonal and management skills.
OSHA 30 hours training preferred
HAZWOPER training preferred

title: Marketing Manager, AI and Lifecycle (Portugal, Remote)
description:
Marketing Manager, AI and Lifecycle
Company: Rove Next, by Rove Concepts

Location: Remote. Open across the Americas and Europe.
Hours: Full-time overlap with Pacific or Eastern time. This is a requirement, not a preference.
Type: Independent contractor, full-time
Apply: []
About the role

Rove Next is a new premium line from Rove Concepts , a Vancouver-based modern furniture brand selling direct to consumer across Canada and the US. Rove Next launches with improved versions of our best-selling pieces, and it needs its own marketing built from the ground up.

That's this role. You'll own how Rove Next reaches customers and keeps them, starting with email and lifecycle. The goal is a marketing function that scales through AI and systems rather than through headcount, and the advantage here is that you're building it clean rather than inheriting one.

This is not a coordination role. We need someone who takes a problem and builds the answer, and who catches things before they reach leadership.

Scope

Initially focused on Rove Next, with room to expand across the Rove Concepts group as the brand grows.

What you'll own

Email and lifecycle as our primary owned channel. Campaign calendar, flows, segmentation, deliverability, list health. We run on Klaviyo.

Quality control on everything that ships. Copy, creative, link destinations, offers, regional versions. If something goes out wrong, it was yours to catch.

Building AI into the daily work. Not proposing it, shipping it.

Working alongside our lifecycle and email team, our designers, and our external ads partner to keep the calendar moving.

Translating results into plain business language. What we spent, what we made, what we'd do differently.

Must-haves

Five or more years in ecommerce or DTC marketing with real ownership of email and lifecycle. Klaviyo or a comparable ESP.

Evidence that you build with AI yourself rather than assigning it. When you hit a wall, your instinct should be to build through it, not to raise a ticket and wait.

Fluent, native-level English, written and spoken. This one is non-negotiable. You will be writing copy that goes out to our customers under our name, so we need someone who can hear the difference between a line that sounds premium and one that sounds like a discount retailer.

A strong eye. You can look at an asset and tell whether the destination matches the promise, whether the tone is right, and whether the offer math actually adds up.

Comfortable being told when something isn't landing, and comfortable telling us the same.

Nice to have

Furniture, home, or another considered-purchase category with a long buying cycle. Shopify, GA4 and Meta Ads familiarity. Experience holding a team to brand guidelines.

What success looks like

Flow revenue grows as a share of total email revenue. Work stops reaching leadership with errors in it. AI is doing measurable work inside the function within 90 days, rather than sitting in a proposal.

Compensation

$3,500 to $4,500 USD per month depending on experience. Independent contractor.

How to apply

Send your CV to []. In a few lines, tell us two things:

One AI workflow or automation you built yourself in a real business. What it did, and what it saved.

One time you caught something before it shipped that nobody else had noticed.

Please also include a short voice note, around 60 seconds, introducing yourself and telling us what you'd want to know before writing your first email for us.

Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a short paid project.

title: AI Content Marketing Manager (f/m/d) B2B
description:
About IONOS

At IONOS, we don't just manage servers - we shape the digital future for more than 6.2 million customers worldwide with our solutions. As Europe's leading hosting provider and a pioneer in independent cloud solutions, we are building next-generation infrastructure - from sovereign cloud architectures and high-performance GPU clusters to integrated AI automation tools.

What drives us is digital sovereignty for Europe and real impact for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) as well as large enterprises. We work in agile teams, rely on transparent structures, and believe that excellence and innovation only emerge through true team spirit.

Ready for your next step? Become part of IONOS and grow with us.

At IONOS, the leading European provider of cloud infrastructure, cloud services and hosting services, you will work together with a wide range of teams. We are characterized by open structures, a friendly working culture and flat hierarchies with a strong team spirit. We firmly believe that work and fun are compatible, and offer you the right environment for this. Our constant growth means that we are always looking for new colleagues. Become part of IONOS and grow with us.

Tasks

• Own content for the B2B Domains marketing team: plan, produce and optimize AI-driven content across the funnel, including landing pages, SEO articles, emails, social posts and ad copy.

• Build and scale AI-powered content workflows such as prompt libraries, templates, agents and quality checks. These help the team ship more content faster while keeping brand quality consistent.

• Develop the content strategy and editorial calendar in line with acquisition and retention goals. Work closely with CRM and performance marketing colleagues to bring content into campaigns and automation flows.

• Drive visibility in search and in AI answers: do keyword and topic research, optimize pages, and structure content so it ranks in search engines and gets cited by AI assistants.

• Design and run content experiments (e.g. A/B tests on landing pages, emails and ads). Measure the impact on traffic, conversion and pipeline, and turn what you learn into next steps.

• Own content reporting: define KPIs, maintain dashboards and share clear insights with the team and stakeholders.

• Bring your own ideas. We run a test-and-learn culture and value fresh perspectives.

Qualifications

• A degree in marketing, communications, journalism, business or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 3+ years of experience in content marketing, growth marketing or SEO, ideally in B2B, SaaS or tech.

• A proven track record of using generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, image/creative tools) in day-to-day content production.

• Experience with agentic AI coding tools such as Claude Code, or with building automated content workflows.

• Excellent writing and editing skills, with a strong feel for tone, structure and copy that converts.

• Solid SEO know-how. Experience optimizing content for AI search is a plus.

• A data-driven way of working: comfortable with web analytics (e.g. GA4), A/B testing and Excel/Sheets. Experience with CMS and marketing automation tools is a plus.

• A structured, self-driven and pragmatic way of working, with the ability to manage several projects and stakeholders at once.

• Knowledge of domains, hosting, cloud or digital infrastructure is a plus.

• Experience in the domain industry is a plus.

• Language proficiency: Fluent English; German is a plus.

Benefits

• Hybrid working model.

• Flexible working hours through trust-based working hours.

• At some locations a subsidized canteen and various free drinks.

• Modern office space with very good transport connections.

• Various employee discounts for activities and products.

• Employee events such as summer and winter parties, as well as workshops.

• Numerous training and development opportunities.

• Various health offers, such as sports and health courses.

title: Staff AI Engineer - Agent Evaluation Platform (x/f/m)
description:
Join a team of passionate and hardworking entrepreneurs to transform healthcare!

 

Working in the tech team at Doctolib involves building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. We work in feature teams in an agile environment, while collaborating with product, design, and business teams.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 

We are looking for a Staff AI Software Engineer to join the AI Evaluation team (EvalX) at Doctolib and help every AI product team measure, understand and improve the quality, reliability and safety of their systems.

 

Our AI products span patient-facing conversational agents, AI-powered phone assistants and clinical assistants supporting healthcare professionals. EvalX builds the platform, tools and methods that let these teams evaluate continuously, and our ambition is to make evaluation a core engineering practice.

 

In this role, you will work at the intersection of platform engineering, applied AI and product teams: you build shared evaluation capabilities, and you work directly with the teams that use them so they actually get adopted.

 

In this role, you will:

- Design, ship, and operate production-grade evaluation tooling (APIs, services, CI/CD integrations) used by AI product teams across Doctolib

- Work hands-on with product teams to assess how they evaluate today, define improvement plans, and help them own their evaluation quality

- Design evaluation strategies for agentic systems, combining deterministic checks, LLM-as-a-judge, simulation-based testing, and human review

- Build intelligent capabilities for production sampling, dataset representativeness monitoring, distribution-shift detection, and test case generation

- Help teams define meaningful quality metrics, representative datasets, and reliable quality gates throughout the development lifecycle

- Turn recurring product needs into reusable, self-service platform capabilities, and measure success through adoption, team autonomy, and evaluation coverage

- Contribute to cross-functional initiatives that shape Doctolib's AI platform and best practices for building and evaluating agentic systems

 

WHO YOU ARE

 

Before you read on, if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply! You could be our next team mate if you:

- Have 6+ years of experience as a software engineer, with significant experience using Python; or as a machine learning engineer

- Have built or operated evaluation for LLM-powered or agentic systems: datasets, LLM-as-a-judge, human review, production-driven evaluation

- Understand and promote software development best practices

- Are product-oriented and enjoy working directly with other teams, challenging assumptions, and turning complex needs into concrete solutions

- Can influence engineering practices and drive change without hierarchical authority: your job is not done until your solution is adopted

- Are comfortable speaking and writing in English in your day-to-day with the team

 

Now, it would be fantastic if you:

- Have experience with applied ML techniques such as embeddings, clustering, statistical sampling, and distribution monitoring

- Have experience building developer platforms or internal tooling, or in a Forward Deployed Engineering role

- Have experience in the medical domain or another regulated environment

 

WHAT WE OFFER

- Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children

- 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT

- Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care http://Moka.care

- Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

- Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib

- A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class

- 50% reimbursement

- Review pairs of e-commerce listings and decide whether they are the same product and the same sellable variant, returning ACCEPT or REJECT.
